source_sentence: The 450◦ C and 500◦ C U-10Mo swelled about 5%–6% with no FGR after two cycles, swelled by about 13% after four cycles with 9% gas release, and then exhibited significant (66% and 45%) gas releases after eight cycles with a marginal increase in swelling to about 18%.
